name: NestNyx
description: Shared-folder-scoped rclone execution API and MCP server for Nyx

NYX_API_KEY.description: Secret key required in the X-Nyx-Key header for the REST API.

NYX_MCP_TOKEN.description: Secret token protecting the MCP endpoint. Use a long random value and never commit it.

RCLONE_CONFIG_B64.description: Base64-encoded rclone.conf. Keep this only in Heroku config vars.

NYX_SHARED_ROOTS_JSON.description: JSON map of logical area names to rclone remote/root and optional expectedOwner.
